title: lolium perenne subsp. italicum
intro: Lolium perenne subsp. italicum, commonly known as Italian ryegrass, is a subspecies of Lolium perenne, a perennial grass native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Lolium perenne subsp. italicum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant on human health.
